messages.snippet: All, Pleased to confirm the Energy Storage Supply, Software Licence and Long-Term Service Agreement
messages.subject: Project Falcon - executed Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Pleased to confirm the Energy Storage Supply, Software Licence and Long-Term Service Agreement for Carrowmoor has been executed today by Verdant and Stratton. Fully-signed PDF attached for your records. Final agreed terms: supply price £62.4m, availability 97.75%, liability cap 135% of trailing Charges with a £17.5m supply super-cap, 7-year LTSA from COD (target 31 March 2027).

Congratulations to both teams.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
